signal: CAI Software merged with Print ePS, making it the Graphic Communications business unit alongside Process and Discrete Manufacturing.

email.subject1: a signal play for CAI's channel
email.body1:
Eric, saw CAI folded Print ePS in as the Graphic Communications unit, giving your channel three operating divisions to cover at once.

A merger like that usually means more partner accounts in play than the team can touch before the motions settle, and that is where co-sell pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for CAI's partner ecosystem off your tech-stack and hiring signals, and accounts showing them progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up on the graphic communications side.

Combining two partner bases rarely comes with double the people to work them, so most channel teams quietly leave co-sell pipeline on the table. The fix is not more reps, it is signal-to-meeting coverage that runs itself across the ecosystem, every touch auto-logged to your CRM.

I sketched a co-sell pilot playbook for CAI's print and manufacturing partners. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through how it maps to your three divisions?
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for CAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis for your channel motion across the merged divisions. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through where the coverage holes are?
email.body4:
Eric, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the merger settles, no problem at all. Integration quarters are their own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets? I will tailor them to CAI either way.
